test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Arrange the parts to form a correct sentence:**

(1) The exhibition opened to the public.

(2) Visitors admired the artworks.

(3) Interactive sessions were conducted.

(4) Feedback was overwhelmingly positive.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct arrangement of the sentences is crucial to ensure a logical flow of events.
 
• The exhibition first opened to the public (**1**).
 
• Then, visitors admired the artworks (**2**).
 
• Next, interactive sessions were conducted (**3**).
 
• Finally, feedback was overwhelmingly positive (**4**).

Therefore, the correct sequence is **1-2-3-4**, which corresponds to **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The exhibition opened to the public. Visitors admired the artworks. Interactive sessions were conducted. Feedback was overwhelmingly positive."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** *1-2-4-3* – Incorrect because feedback (4) cannot come before interactive sessions (3).
 
• **Option 3:** *2-3-1-4* – Incorrect because the exhibition (1) must open before visitors admire the artworks (2).
 
• **Option 4:** *4-3-2-1* – Incorrect sequence of events.
